+7. Determine if the requested memory access is allowed by the _XWR_ bits
+   If not, stop and raise an access-fault exception corresponding to the
+   original access type, else the requested memory access is allowed.

+   ** The MXR mechanisms or the use of HLVX instruction cannot be used to affect
+   or override the interpretation of permissions encoded in
+   memory-protection-table entries.

+   ** When Zicfiss extension is also implemented, the memory accessed by the
+   shadow stack instructions require read-write permission in MPT entries.
